relation_statement: Optimizer parameter shard views must be detached from autograd (carry no grad_fn) so FP32 parameter gradients are not double-counted.
observable_signal: grad_fn present on the FP32 shard view; doubled gradient contribution for FP32 parameters relative to the FP16/BF16 path
validity_precondition: DistributedOptimizer with FP32 master parameters (e.g. embeddings, layernorm) under mixed-precision training
evidence_from_issue: DistributedOptimizer FP32 shard_model_param uses non-detached view, so the parameter shard participates in autograd and accumulates spurious grad_fn
evidence_from_fix: the FP32 view kept grad_fn alive; an extra grad chain was created, leading to silently doubled gradient contributions for FP32 parameters, inconsistent with the FP16/BF16 path

relation_statement: Backward gradients under fp16 autocast must remain within fp16's representable range (via loss scaling) rather than systematically underflowing to zero, when no framework loss-scaler path is active.
observable_signal: fraction of exactly-zero gradient elements / collapse of gradient norm toward zero across steps
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 0 with torch.autocast(fp16) and no GradScaler instantiated
evidence_from_issue: trains without a GradScaler — fp16 gradients underflow to zero
evidence_from_fix: backward propagated unscaled fp16 grads; anything below ~6e-5 flushes to 0, optimizer applies near-zero updates and training stalls

relation_statement: Trainable parameters must remain full precision and nontrainable parameters must be quantized exactly as the zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights config requests during zero.Init.
observable_signal: per-parameter dtype/quantization state of trainable vs nontrainable parameters compared against the configured policy
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 3 with zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights=True in config and no explicit constructor kwarg
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO3 quantized_nontrainable_weights flag overwrites quantized_weights instead
evidence_from_fix: the code mistakenly assigns the value to self.quantized_weights instead of self.quantized_nontrainable_weights — a copy-paste typo; trainable weights end up quantized while nontrainable weights stay full precision

relation_statement: Config encode/decode round-trip must reproduce an equivalent config, excluding init=False derived fields, under guard: dataclass with field(init=False).
observable_signal: Equality of decode(encode(config)) vs original; crash on unknown kwargs or stale derived value.
validity_precondition: Config dataclass has field(init=False) derived fields and is serialized via as_dict
evidence_from_issue: Config encoding ignores field.init=False — non-init dataclass fields silently round-trip with stale values
evidence_from_fix: as_dict dumped init=False fields, re-passed to constructor, overwriting post_init-derived values

relation_statement: Rotary positions for each batch element must be computed against that element's own document boundaries under guard: B>1 with differing per-element doc layouts.
observable_signal: Positions/doc indices for batch element >0 vs its own cu_doc_lens boundaries.
validity_precondition: packed-document training with cu_doc_lens, batch_size>1, per-element differing boundaries
evidence_from_issue: RotaryEmbedding cu_doc_lens path miscomputes positions for B>1 — second batch element reuses batch-0 doc layout
evidence_from_fix: positions=arange(k_len) without per-batch offset; searchsorted against batch-0 boundaries

relation_statement: Attention must respect causal ordering: token t may attend only to positions <= t (future positions masked) in autoregressive training.
observable_signal: Attention probability mass on future positions (must be zero); equivalently, perturbing a future token must not change the output at earlier positions.
validity_precondition: Causal (autoregressive) attention layers during training
evidence_from_issue: Attention causal mask inverted — future tokens attend to past
evidence_from_fix: 1 - triu() masks the lower triangle instead of upper, inverting causal attention

relation_statement: The gathered activation tensor passed to the fused wgrad GEMM must be contiguous in memory under sequence-parallel TP with gradient accumulation fusion.
observable_signal: all_gathered_input.is_contiguous() flag at fused wgrad kernel entry
validity_precondition: sequence parallel with gradient_accumulation_fusion and upstream reshape/transpose chains that can produce strided tensors
evidence_from_issue: prepare_input_tensors_for_wgrad_compute does not enforce all_gathered_input.contiguous(), so wgrad GEMM reads a non-contiguous strided tensor as if it were contiguous
evidence_from_fix: the fused kernel indexes the buffer via flat data_ptr arithmetic; it reads the wrong elements while tensor metadata looks valid, so wgrad accumulation produces silently incorrect numbers

relation_statement: The per-token loss scale must include the context_parallel_size factor so the effective gradient matches the CP=1 reference.
observable_signal: gradient magnitude ratio between CP>1 and CP=1 runs (off by 1/cp_size)
validity_precondition: calculate_per_token_loss=True in loss function and pipeline forward_step
evidence_from_issue: calculate_per_token_loss with CP misses context_parallel_size scale factor
evidence_from_fix: with per-token loss the CP factor was missing, so when CP later divided again the resulting gradient was off by 1/cp_size

relation_statement: Expert/router gradients must flow unmasked (not zeroed) unless the freeze mode is active under guard: plain TransformerTrainModule.
observable_signal: Gradient norm of the first-half expert/router parameters during a normal (non-freeze) training run.
validity_precondition: TransformerTrainModule used directly, params named 'experts'/'router', freeze off
evidence_from_issue: Expert/router gradients zeroed unconditionally in train_batch — first-half mask applied even when freeze_experts is off
evidence_from_fix: freeze masking moved to module-level train_batch so parent zeroed first half of experts on every run

relation_statement: Each epoch must yield the full reshuffled index set exactly once (start offset reset to 0) under guard: epoch boundary crossing.
observable_signal: Count of examples yielded in an epoch vs dataset length; dataset.start_index at epoch start.
validity_precondition: max_epochs>1, crossing an epoch boundary mid-training
evidence_from_issue: Dataset start_index not reset when starting a new epoch
evidence_from_fix: forgot to reset self.dataset.start_index=0, so new epoch dropped a prefix and was shortened

relation_statement: Parameter-sync launches must be issued for every microbatch id up to total_num_microbatches, aligned across PP ranks, under interleaved pipelining with param_sync_func set.
observable_signal: per-step count of param-sync invocations compared against total_num_microbatches on each PP rank
validity_precondition: interleaved pipeline parallelism with config.param_sync_func set and num_model_chunks >= 3
evidence_from_issue: forward_backward_pipelining_with_interleaving uses num_microbatches instead of total_num_microbatches in the param-sync gate
evidence_from_fix: condition `param_sync_microbatch_id < num_microbatches` should be `< total_num_microbatches`; only first num_microbatches param-syncs were aligned across PP ranks

relation_statement: Reported cumulative Gflops must be proportional to the total number of tokens processed (accumulating monotonically across resumes) whenever speed monitoring is enabled.
observable_signal: Ratio of reported cumulative Gflops to global_total_tokens; a per-step reset or a value scaling with batch count instead of token count witnesses the violation.
validity_precondition: Speed/FLOPs monitoring enabled, especially across checkpoint restarts
evidence_from_issue: FLOPs counter multiplies per-sequence flops by global batch size every step instead of accumulating per token
evidence_from_fix: after resume the running total was overwritten/reset per step rather than treated as cumulative; fix assigns Gflops = (fwd+bck) * global_total_tokens / 1e9

relation_statement: reset_parameters must run for the standard-parametrization baseline (infshapes=None) so params are not left FSDP-default under guard: SP coord-check load path.
observable_signal: Parameter std / near-zero check for the SP baseline after load_model.
validity_precondition: mup_olmo coord-check SP baseline path with infshapes=None
evidence_from_issue: load_model in mup coord-check skips reset_parameters when infshapes is None
evidence_from_fix: reset_parameters nested inside if infshapes is not None, so SP baseline skipped it, leaving default near-zero params

relation_statement: The loss value driving skip-step statistics, and hence the skip decision, must be identical across all ranks under guard world_size > 1.
observable_signal: per-rank latest_loss values or skip-step decision bits differing across ranks at the same step
validity_precondition: skip-step optimizer active; loss consumed before the global all-reduce
evidence_from_issue: SkipStepOptimizer fed unreduced ce_batch_loss — skip decisions on per-rank values
evidence_from_fix: latest_loss was set from the local per-rank loss before the all-reduce; skip-step decisions diverged across ranks, producing inconsistent optimizer behavior

relation_statement: Each rank's contribution to the globally reduced loss must be proportional to its count of kept (unmasked) tokens under guard that per-rank sum-then-allreduce averaging is used.
observable_signal: globally reduced loss/gradient magnitude compared against a token-count-weighted reference average across ranks
validity_precondition: instance_mask present in the batch and at least one rank has masked instances
evidence_from_issue: Instance filter loss divisor missed masked-out instance tokens — wrong gradient scale
evidence_from_fix: ranks with fewer kept tokens contributed an artificially large per-token loss, producing an unfair weighted average across the data-parallel group and a wrong gradient magnitude

relation_statement: The second sequence-parallel all-to-all output must reconstruct the exact head-to-rank permutation of its input when num_heads is not divisible by seq_world_size.
observable_signal: element-wise mismatch of attention output against a single-rank (SP=1) reference execution
validity_precondition: sequence-parallel single_all_to_all second all2all (scatter_idx<2) with num_heads % seq_world_size != 0 and get_num_kv_heads() None
evidence_from_issue: single_all_to_all routes uneven-head path on second all2all when divisibility fails
evidence_from_fix: buggy gate routes to uneven_heads_all2all even on the second all2all; uneven path does not produce correct output for second all2all

relation_statement: The runtime device placement and distributed mode must match the actually available/requested backend (CUDA hosts must not be silently rewritten to MPS/CPU with distributed disabled) at startup.
observable_signal: Device type of initialized model parameters and the active distributed world size vs the launched configuration; CUDA available but init_device forced to 'mps' with distributed off witnesses the violation.
validity_precondition: Training entrypoint performing backend/device auto-detection
evidence_from_issue: torch.device('mps') used as boolean check is always truthy, forces every run into MPS/CPU mode
evidence_from_fix: the condition is always True because torch.device(...) returns a non-None object ... unconditionally rewrites init_device to 'mps' and disables distributed training even on CUDA hosts; fix uses torch.backends.mps.is_available()

relation_statement: The logged z-loss metric must be averaged over the participating ranks so the reported value equals the cross-rank mean (identical on all ranks) under multi-rank training.
observable_signal: Per-rank logged z-loss values: divergence across ranks (no reduction applied) witnesses the missing avg_group.
validity_precondition: z-loss enabled and metric tracking/logging active across multiple ranks
evidence_from_issue: z-loss metric tracking missing avg_group — not averaged across ranks
evidence_from_fix: (no root_cause text provided; inferred from title: reduction group not passed to the metric averaging)

relation_statement: The param-to-partition-owner bookkeeping table must agree with the actual round-robin gradient reduction destination for every parameter under ZeRO-2 with round_robin_gradients.
observable_signal: parameters whose weights never change across steps despite nonzero gradients (gradient attributed to the wrong owner)
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 2 with round_robin_gradients=True
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO2 round-robin gradient partitioning uses non-reordered group, mapping params to wrong partition owner
evidence_from_fix: bookkeeping iterated over self.fp16_groups (original order) while reduction uses self.round_robin_fp16_groups; some params' gradients were attributed to the wrong owner and never appeared in the optimizer step

relation_statement: The dataloader's reported length must equal the number of batches it actually yields (samples/batch_size with drop_last semantics), whenever downstream schedules consume it.
observable_signal: len(dataloader) vs the count of batches produced by one full iteration
validity_precondition: any consumer of len(dataloader) (lr schedule total steps, max_steps detection) with batch_size > 1
evidence_from_issue: DeepSpeedDataLoader.len reports sampler length, ignores batch_size and drop_last
evidence_from_fix: self.len was set to len(data_sampler), the sample count; callers received sample count instead of batch count, off by ~batch_size×

relation_statement: A named data-mix enum key must map to the corpus path it names under guard: user selects the 0625 mix.
observable_signal: Resolved corpus path/identity vs the requested mix name (0625 vs 0725).
validity_precondition: user selects DataMix.OLMo_midtraining_mix_0625_100B
evidence_from_issue: OLMo midtraining mix key references the wrong file — '0625' name maps to '0725' path
evidence_from_fix: enum value OLMo_midtraining_mix_0625_100B='...0725-100B' silently routed to the July mix

relation_statement: After optimizer.step(), each rank's 16-bit parameter partition must equal the cast of its own fp32 master partition, using each param group's own process-group rank, under MoE with expert-parallel groups.
observable_signal: elementwise difference between each rank's bit16 partition and its corresponding fp32 master partition after step
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 2 with MoE where expert parallel groups differ from the data parallel group
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO2 + MoE: fp32→fp16 master-weight copy uses outer-loop partition_id, writing into wrong rank's slice
evidence_from_fix: the loop used a single partition_id from the outer scope; with MoE different param groups use different real_dp_process_group, so the wrong partition slot was overwritten and the local rank's actual partition was never updated

relation_statement: The averaged/reduced region of the gradient bucket buffer must cover exactly the valid gradient elements, excluding the uninitialized tail, whenever the bucket flushes before it is full.
observable_signal: reduced-buffer extent vs elements_in_ipg_bucket; contamination of end-of-bucket gradients relative to a full-precision recompute (nondeterministic garbage-dependent values)
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 1/2, contiguous_gradients=True, bucket flushed with elements_in_ipg_bucket < reduce_bucket_size
evidence_from_issue: IPG buffer averaged over full allocated size — averages garbage from unused tail elements
evidence_from_fix: only elements_in_ipg_bucket are valid; stale tail floats get included in the all-reduce sum and divide, contaminating the averaged gradient slice near the end of the buffer

relation_statement: Router gate scores must remain strictly positive (bounded away from exact zero) before any downstream log or divide under guard that a sigmoid gating function runs in low precision.
observable_signal: min of router scores hitting exactly 0.0, or -inf/NaN appearing in the aux/load-balancing loss
validity_precondition: MoE router with sigmoid gating; downstream code takes log or divides by the score
evidence_from_issue: F.sigmoid(logits) without epsilon — exact-zero scores propagate as NaN through downstream log
evidence_from_fix: scores could underflow to exactly 0.0 under low precision, and downstream log/divide produced -inf/NaN that silently propagated into the final loss

relation_statement: Allreduced sparse gradients must be written back into the parameter's grad so no gradient contribution is dropped under DP>1.
observable_signal: sparse embedding parameters showing zero update across steps despite nonzero local gradients
validity_precondition: modules producing sparse gradients (e.g. embedding with sparse=True)
evidence_from_issue: Sparse gradients silently not updating — SparseTensor wraps .data instead of param.grad
evidence_from_fix: Python re-bound the local name and never wrote back into param.grad; the post-allreduce values lived on a temporary SparseTensor with no link to the parameter — sparse embedding gradients were silently dropped
